rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=6, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0023, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=7, img_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, rationale=iter-10: WARM-START-ANCHOR probe. ONE knob changed vs the iter-6 hr-best PEAK base (pretrain_epochs 3->6, the amortized warm-start pre-pass length); all 18 other fields held IDENTICAL to demo_dl_dual_domain_bilateral_n2i_iter_06.json (seed=42, val_n=6, img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 LOOSE demo-correct, n_iter=400, lr=2.3e-3, grad_clip=1.0, warm_start=True) -> directly comparable to iter-6 hr 0.3330 / PSNR 20.18 / SSIM 0.7796 on the SAME seed=42 val_n=6 split. pretrain_epochs is a genuinely NEW axis -- pinned at 3 across iters 1-9. Read iter-6 PEAK + iter-8/9 BY HEADROOM (campaign primary, PSNR/noise-sensitive on demo): iter-6 seed=42 val_n=6 hr 0.3330 (PSNR 20.18, SSIM 0.7796); iter-8 seed 42->123 hr 0.4222 (PSNR 17.81, SSIM 0.7711); iter-9 val_n 6->12 at seed=123 hr 0.4099 (PSNR 18.61) -- the val_n=12 check CONFIRMED hr~0.41 is REAL on the seed-123 draw (not a 6-scene lucky split), but that regime carries the LOWER PSNR (17.8-18.6 vs 20.18), so hr and PSNR DIVERGE across seeds. FAILURE MODE at hr~0.42: the 6-param bilateral sits at its structural noise-floor ceiling on the 64-view (half of 128) FBP -- both proven capacity levers are EXHAUSTED: image-domain DEPTH (img_n_bf, hr slope collapsed to ~0 by n_bf=5: 1->3 +0.051, 3->5 +0.006, 5->7 +0.000) AND per-scan OPTIMIZER budget (n_iter, flat 400->800; the 6-param bilateral physically CANNOT overfit one scan). img_sr is EXHAUSTED + substrate-confirmed WRONG-direction (demo wants LOOSE 0.02; tightening to 0.0005 collapsed hr 0.3335->0.1998 at iter-4 -- do NOT repeat). proj_n_bf is in the symmetry trap (near-identity proj sigmas -> wasted params). The ONLY genuinely-new, MOTIVATED axis left at the PEAK base is the WARM-START ANCHOR QUALITY. warm_start is LOAD-BEARING-POSITIVE (mayo_campaign_state.md: turning it off cost demo-n2i -0.06, mayo -0.015) and the per-scan fit anchors on the amortized warm-start init; its length (pretrain_epochs) has never been varied. HYPOTHESIS (warm-start-anchor): doubling pretrain_epochs 3->6 gives the amortized warm-start pre-pass more steps to converge to a cleaner bilateral init, so each per-scan _fit_one_scene lands in a better basin -> lifts hr/PSNR above iter-6 (hr 0.333 / PSNR 20.18) on the SAME seed=42 split. If hr/PSNR stay FLAT, it CONFIRMS the warm-start anchor is already saturated by 3 epochs and the ~hr 0.33 ceiling is init-length-independent -- a clean ceiling-doc result toward iter-20. Chose pretrain_epochs over (a) img_n_bf 7->9 (depth lever hr slope is DEAD FLAT, near-zero EV), (b) img_sr (exhausted, wrong-direction), (c) proj_n_bf / proj BF knobs (symmetry trap, wasted params), (d) grad_clip (mandatory at 1.0, an overflow guard not a quality lever), (e) n_iter (exhausted, flat at 800). Held fixed at iter-6 PEAK values: seed=42, val_n=6, img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 (LOOSE, demo-correct), n_iter=400, proj_n_bf=1, kernels (proj_k=7/img_k=5), proj sigmas (1.0/2.0/0.02), img spatial sigmas (img_sx=1.5/img_sy=1.5), lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, train_n=200, grad_clip=1.0 (-> identical val split, directly comparable to iter-6). Wall: iter-6 ran 828 s at pretrain_epochs=3/n_iter=400/val_n=6; doubling pretrain adds 3x200=600 more warm-start steps on cheap 128-view FBP (~+60-90 s) -> est ~900 s, well under the 1800 s sbatch wall and the 1200 s outer_wall_s internal guard (under the 15-min budget). This iter PROBES the last untested anchor axis toward iter-20. PER-IMAGE bilateral N2I, AGENT4CT_DATASET=phantoms; warm_start STAYS ON; do NOT revert to amortized.
